code-lines.json.shape: per script: path, bytes, sha256, lines, longest, runs
code-lines.json.meaning: the real line structure of the series' scripts (the kit's bake/root_to_csv.py and bake/d0.py) for dk-pipeline's code stage; no source text

d0-checks.json.meaning: chi2 at the fit's start values; sha256 of d0-fit.json from two passes of the bake

d0-fit.json.meaning: the mass fit: start values, logged iterations (dk-curve params), result, pulls, window stability, PDG gap in sigma, mass/momentum scale shift, row 1 P(signal)

d0-hist.json.meaning: 2 MeV mass histograms over the full range (all, IPchi2 < 9, sum of P(signal)), the 45-bin fit range, row 1's bin

d0-peaks.f32.meaning: fitted peak mu (MeV/c^2) of each of d0-select.json's selections in selection order (0 = no cut); for a dk-hist of the peaks with cols ['MU'], key 'MU'

d0-select.json.meaning: 6 x 5 x 4 selections as cuts on d0.f32 columns (PT >, IPCHI2 <, TAU >) with the fitted peak of each; the counts of selections 0 and 119; how many peaks lie near selection 0's

d0.f32.meaning: record 401 candidates in file order: M MeV/c2, PT MeV/c, TAU ps (NaN = missing), IPCHI2

d0.json.meaning: d0.f32's header: n, cols, units, row 1, value ranges, source block

portal.json.meaning: CERN Open Data portal record count (and by experiment / type / availability) with its date
